records.deidentified_narrative: du1 was driving in the wal-mart parking lot. du1 was driving north bound in the front by the grocery entrance. du1 stated that he slowed down and looked to see if anyone was coming before he started to go through the crosswalk. du1 stated that while he was driving he got a text message and he looked at his phone. du1 stated that he had his phone up by his dashboard so that he could [roadway]. du1 stated that u2 walked into his vehicle. u2 then leaned up against u1 telling du1 you hit me. u2 stated that he was walking out of the store into the parking lot. u2 stated that he saw du1 driving and looking down at his phone. u2 stated that he thought to him self should i stop walking or is du1 going to see me and stop. u2 then said he was not even done with his thought and u1 and u2 collided. ofc. carnevale # 513 and det. santos # 2010 looked at the video of the crash. both stated that in their opinion it appeared as if u2 walked into u1. u2 had a abrasion to his right knee. u1 rubbed against u2's knee as he was driving leaving a scrape like a rug burn. he refused any treatment. u2 also stated that his right wrist hurt. in my opinion both are at fault. du1 looked at his phone and may have been able to avoid the crash all together. u2 seemed like he could have just stopped walking instead of walking into a moving vehicle.

records.public_safe_text: on [date] at approximately 3:30 a. m. officer s. ahrens #[roadway], in the city of duncanville, dallas county, texas in response to a major disturbance. officer ahrens arrived and made contact with dean c barker (a black male born [date] with texas driver license [identifier]). during the course of the investigation it was determined dean c barker`s 2019 hyundai sonata bearing texas license plate [identifier] was stolen by wesley alan wolfe (a white male born [date] positively identified by his photo texas identification card [identifier]). after the vehicle was stolen wesley alan wolfe exited the parking lot at a high rate of speed, striking dean c barker with the vehicle in the process (see related offense report 20000011). before exiting the parking lot, wesley alan wolfe crashed the hyundai sonata into a grey toyota rav4 bearing texas license plate [identifier]. the resulting crash caused the toyota rav4 to be pushed into a black chevrolet trax bearing texas license plate [identifier] which was parked next to the toyota rav4. officer ahrens observed damage to the front driver side bumper of the hyundai sonata, rear driver and passenger side damage to the toyota rav4, and rear driver side damage to the chevrolet trax. the damage to all three vehicles corroborates the version of events provided by dean c barker. following the crash, wesley alan wolfe fled the scene. wesley alan wolfe was later located in the [roadway], desoto next to the recently stolen vehicle. wesley alan wolfe was placed under arrest and transported to the duncanville city jail. the hyundai sonata was towed from the scene and later released to dean c barker. the toyota rav4 and chevrolet trax both belonged to raymond hall jr (a black male born [date] with texas driver license # 22353940). raymond hall jr was informed of the damage and advised he wished to press charges against the suspect (who was not positively identified until after officer ahrens cleared the initial scene). raymond hall jr completed a written statement which was later placed in the records / cid tray. raymond hall jr advised he would provide a written estimate of the damages once it became available. officer ahrens body worn camera footage was later attached to the report. an in custody aggravated robbery warrant and affidavit were completed for wesley alan wolfe. an additional warrant and affidavit will be completed once an estimate of damages is obtained. a crash report was completed in conjunction with the offense report. there is no further information at this time.
